message.subject: EDXSO partnership proposal
message.email_body: Sam Hlabangana, your video on the iPhone 18 Pro Burgundy unboxing caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes, leadership and sustainable institutional growth. We want to propose an exploratory sponsored walkthrough video for teachers and school leaders, with format and terms to be discussed. This gives teachers, academic leaders and school decision makers practical technology insights for their institutions. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
